d: A tragic helicopter crash occurred while a helicopter was travelling from Badrinath to Dehradun in Uttarakhand, claiming the lives of six people. The incident has raised serious questions about aviation safety and the circumstances surrounding the accident. What exactly happened before the helicopter crashed? What did one of the passengers say before boarding the flight? A statement made just before take-off has now drawn attention, adding an emotional dimension to the tragedy. Watch this video for details of the helicopter crash, the latest developments, rescue efforts, and the questions…
